decisions.title: Rebalance with new contributions first
decisions.decision: Direct new savings to US and international equity until the mix is within 5 points of target; sell nothing this quarter.
decisions.rationale: The drift is contribution-fixable at the demo savings pace, and selling would realize gains for no benefit.
decisions.falsification: If two quarters of contributions cannot close half the US-equity gap, the no-sell rule gets revisited.

decisions.title: Stage the cash trim in two moves
decisions.decision: Trim the Treasury reserve halfway to target now and the rest after the January review.
decisions.rationale: Keeps reserves above the floor through the enrollment and tax checkpoints.
decisions.falsification: If reserves would dip below $24,000 at either stage, the second stage is cancelled.

decisions.title: Keep the HSA in the Treasury reserve
decisions.decision: Leave the Family HSA invested in the Carter Treasury Reserve rather than moving it into the broad market index.
decisions.rationale: Medical spending in the demo year ran close to the HSA balance, so the reserve's stability mattered more than the index's expected return.
decisions.falsification: A year of low medical spending with the HSA balance above $10,000 would have argued for investing the excess.
decisions.outcome: Kept in the reserve fund; demo medical spending stayed inside the card-paid budget.
